panels.rationale: Real patient echocardiogram with caption-supported saccular left main coronary artery dilatation and aneurysmal LAD dilatation, specific coronary manifestations of Kawasaki disease.

panels.figure_caption: Two-dimensional echocardiography of case 3 showing saccular dilatation of the origin of left main coronary artery (LCA) (arrow) and aneurysmal dilatation of left anterior descending (LAD) artery.
in_text_mentions: A diagnosis of atypical Kawasaki was considered and echocardiography was requested. The day after admission, he had desquamation of the skin at his fingertips and perianal region (Figure 2). Echocardiographic examination revealed saccular dilatation of the origin of left main coronary artery (LCA) and aneurysmal dilatation of left anterior descending (LAD) artery (Figure 3).
